dedupe_keys.name: 生活支援交通 よりみちハス bus and public transit

description: 生活支援交通「よりみちバス」 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 久留米市. よりみちバスは、10人乗車両を用いて、決まったルートを決まった時間に走り、どなたでも利用できるコミュニティバスです。 平成27年12月18日より北野地域で、平成28年3月1日より城島地域で運行を開始しています。 国土交通省が定める「標準的なバス情報フォーマット」です。. Coverage: 久留米市. The portal files it under the publisher 久留米市. Its tags are GTFS, バス, 交通, 運輸. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
